property_summary: For any caller address, the reference contract allows the first call to SetLogFile(...) to succeed and subsequent calls to SetLogFile(...) (by any caller) also succeed while the buggy mutant which never resets the reentrancy lock will cause subsequent SetLogFile calls to revert (i.e., the contract becomes permanently locked after the first nonReentrant_ call).
change_summary: Modify nonReentrant_ modifier to not reset the lock flag after function execution, leaving locked_ permanently true and thus preventing subsequent SetLogFile calls from succeeding.
